question: Who among the following is the first Indian woman mountaineer to climb Mount Everest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bachendri Pal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Bachendri Pal** became the **first Indian woman to climb Mount Everest** on **23rd May 1984**.

• She was a part of the **Indian expedition to Mount Everest** in 1984, which was organized by the **Indian Mountaineering Foundation**.

• Her achievement marked a significant milestone in Indian mountaineering history and inspired many women in India to pursue mountaineering.

• Bachendri Pal hails from a small village in Uttarkashi district of **Uttarakhand** and is known for her determination and perseverance.

• She has been honored with several awards for her achievement, including the **Padma Shri** in 1984 and the **Arjuna Award** in 1986.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Ruma Pal:** 

• Ruma Pal is a renowned legal personality and served as a **judge of the Supreme Court of India**.

• She has no association with mountaineering or climbing Mount Everest.

• **Cornelia Sorabji:** 

• Cornelia Sorabji was the **first woman to practice law in India**.

• She is known for her contributions to the legal field and women's rights but has no connection with mountaineering.

• **Shikha Sharma:** 

• Shikha Sharma is a well-known Indian banker and the former Managing Director & CEO of **Axis Bank**.

• She is not related to mountaineering or climbing Mount Everest.

• **Legacy of Bachendri Pal:** 

• After her Everest expedition, she continued to inspire young mountaineers by leading several expeditions, including the **First All-Women Trans-Himalayan Expedition** in 1997.

• She served as the director of the **Tata Steel Adventure Foundation**, promoting adventure sports and mountaineering in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **First Indian Woman on Everest:** Bachendri Pal’s achievement made her a national icon, showcasing the potential of Indian women in adventure sports.

• **Awards and Recognition:** Apart from the Padma Shri and Arjuna Award, she has also received the **National Adventure Award**.

• **Inspiration:** Her success encouraged many Indian women to take up mountaineering and adventure sports, breaking societal stereotypes.

• **Mount Everest Facts:** Mount Everest, with an elevation of **8,848.86 meters**, is the highest peak in the world, located in the **Himalayas on the Nepal-China border**.
